<div class="about-bio">
  <p>
    I am a postdoctoral research fellow at INRS working for the Canadian Municipal Barometer. I research Canadian politics with a focus on provincial party systems, urban and local politics, and public policy. My dissertation research used election platforms to investigate party position change and programmatic polarization in provincial elections since 1945. My work draws on various tools, such as quantitative text analysis, archival research, and interviews. 
  </p>
  <p>
    I completed my doctoral studies in the Department of Political Science at the University of Western Ontario. I have taught undergraduate quantitative methods and public policy courses. I am also an active member of my community — I am a Director and Vice-Chair for a non-profit organization, Nature's Calling Environmental Education. 
  </p>
